# xstockstrat — Constitution (root / platform)

Captures the seams **between** services — cross-cutting invariants no single service's files reveal.
xstockstrat's `C-*/P-*/F-*` scheme governs the SDD *process*; these are *codebase invariants*, so they
use a sibling namespace `PLAT-*` (CF-N5). Module constitutions inherit these and stay thin.

> The behavioral contract (4 behaviors) is prepended to this target's `CLAUDE.md`, not stored here.
